source.name: Activating a form control inside a modal must not close the modal
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/ghosh/micromodal/issues/487) at 98e003a01a6821a309f6feebc3a298e1cf472baa. Blind to the maintainers' fix c2c7d1563fc24775abd8b3fd8ba79ae85ccafe47; routing auto.

journey.title: Ticking a checkbox inside the preferences dialog keeps it open
journey.goal: Space ticks the checkbox and the dialog stays open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close preferences with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: The dialog opens and the close button dismisses it

guards.title: Done closes the preferences dialog from the keyboard
guards.goal: Activating Done dismisses the dialog and focus returns to the trigger

attempts.failure: Expected ',' or ']' after array element in JSON at position 1244 (line 11 column 34)

plan.root_cause: The overlay element has data-micromodal-close, causing clicks inside the dialog (including Space-triggered click on the checkbox) to bubble up and close the modal.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the close trigger from the overlay so that only the close button and Done button close the modal. This prevents the checkbox click from closing the dialog while preserving keyboard accessibility.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: The dialog remains open when toggling checkboxes via Space, allowing keyboard users to change preferences without losing context. Focus stays on the checkbox, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3.
functional_risks: Clicking the overlay backdrop no longer closes the modal, which may be a UX change but is not covered by tests.
verification_requirements: Run the journey to confirm Space toggles weekly checkbox and dialog stays open.
Verify Done button and close button still close the dialog.
Check that form data includes 'weekly' after Space press.
